scientific_integrity: The analytic proof supplies infinite-dimensional assertions; finite executable tests are supplemental. Priority and correctness lack independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Polynomial weights and nonlinear integer powers only; compact singular-value constants are two-sided and not asymptotic coefficients; general aliases in historical block Toeplitz literature remain possible.
title: Polyphase essential spectrum and Schatten threshold for polynomially weighted nonlinear dilations
